mission.title: What's in the Box?
mission.description: Interview the witnesses who have seen strange boxes in the City.

npc.say: That's about all I can tell you... honestly, I don't remember anything else about it. I don't know if anybody else saw it or not.
That's all I can remember, I swear!

phase.briefing:
The Assassin has been destroyed. A great blight upon the Matrix has been removed. I am pleased.
However, we have received numerous... troubling reports recently, involving certain strange boxes. You must interview one of the witnesses, Sachiko Warren. Find out what she knows.

enter.say: Here we are at Warren's office.

talk.say:
What... you're who? Oh, feds. Well yeah, like I told the man on the phone: I was walking to the bus stop last night, minding my own business, when this weird box was there on the street! I'm sure it hadn't been there before, but I didn't see who brought it. It was really big -- maybe ten feet tall! There was this smoke or fog around it, and I was afraid it might be a terrorist attack, so I ran to get a police officer. When we got back, the box was gone.
I don't know why you're taking such an interest -- the police just seem to think I'm crazy!

done.say: Strange boxes... appearing and disappearing... huh. Well, I don't think you're going to get much else out of her. You can leave.

phase.briefing:
That was rather... unsatisfying. We need more concrete evidence, more details, more... information.
The next location is the home of Royal Phillips, another witness. I expect you to apply a little more pressure to Mr. Phillips.

enter.say: I think you'd better find out more this time, {player}... Gray sounded a little peeved.

talk.say:
What? Of course I'll tell you... yes...
Well, I saw this weird box the other day. It was huge, and it looked kinda out of place or something. It was just sitting on a street corner. I honestly didn't see how it got there, I was just on my way to the grocery store!
Okay, I'm thinking! Um... yeah, I guess there was someone there! There was this guy nearby, he looked kinda suspicious. I guess because he was wearing this bandana. I figured he was in some sort of gang, or something. I didn't stick around to ask any questions.

done.say: Bingo. Let's get out of here.

phase.briefing:
This is most intriguing, {player}. The masked men are apparently somehow linked to these boxes.
I have one more witness for you to visit, Shaquana Hassam. Find out what Ms. Hassam knows.

enter.say: Uh oh, looks like we've got hostiles on site! Take 'em out, {player}.

mission.finish:
These commandos are becoming a... nuisance.
Remain in contact, {player}. Action will be taken.
